title: Microsoft Purview: connector that brings ChatGPT Enterprise prompts and responses into Purview
notes: claim 74: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the briefing overstates who can search captured conversations and understates who can view their text. Its billing setup instructions also omit the different consent route required for existing classic Azure Purview customers; the roadmap facts and the connector's preview prerequisites are supported.
